# Accessibility Checklist: Interactive architecture diagram on the Technology page

**Purpose**: Validate that the accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA) requirements for the diagram, its explanations and its interaction model are complete, clear, consistent and measurable
**Created**: 2026-10-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Items test the quality of the written requirements, not the implementation.

## Accessible Names and Structure

- [x] CHK001 Is the accessible name required for each of the 12 parts defined, including whether it must match the visible label? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK002 Is a text alternative for the connections (which part calls which) required for users who cannot see the lines? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK003 Is it specified how the diagram as a whole is exposed (name, description, role) to assistive technology? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK004 Are heading structure requirements defined for the diagram, the explanations list and the retained sections? [Gap, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK005 Does the spec define what a screen reader announces on activation of a part ("its explanation"), and is that wording measurable? [Ambiguity, Spec §US2.4]
- [x] CHK006 Are the purpose and accessible name of the "Back to diagram" link specified so repeated links are distinguishable per part? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]

## Keyboard and Focus

- [x] CHK007 Is the keyboard tab order of the 12 parts defined, and is "sensible order" made objective? [Ambiguity, Spec §US2.4]
- [x] CHK008 Is the keyboard activation set (Tab, Enter, others) stated consistently between User Story 2 and SC-002? [Consistency, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK009 Is focus placement after activating a part (entry vs. part) specified for both JavaScript and no-JavaScript modes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK010 Is focus return specified when "Back to diagram" is used without JavaScript, and when the part no longer exists? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK011 Are focus-visible requirements quantified (indicator contrast, minimum size, not obscured) to cover WCAG 2.2 Focus Appearance and Focus Not Obscured? [Measurability, Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK012 Is the absence of keyboard traps inside the SVG a stated requirement beyond SC-002's check? [Coverage, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK013 Are target-size requirements (WCAG 2.2 Target Size, 24 px minimum) defined for parts and links on a 320 px screen? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK014 Are requirements defined for arriving by fragment link (focus and scroll position of the entry)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]

## Visual Presentation and Contrast

- [x] CHK015 Are contrast thresholds stated per element type (label text, lines, part borders, selected and focus states) for both themes? [Measurability, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK016 Is the selected state required to be distinguishable without relying on colour alone? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK017 Are forced-colours / high-contrast mode requirements defined for parts, lines and the selected state? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK018 Are the 14 px and 12 px minimum label sizes defined by a measurable rule (rendered size after scaling, not authored units)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK019 Is the narrowest supported width defined consistently (320 px) across user story, edge case and success criteria? [Consistency, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK020 Are reflow and text-resize requirements (200% zoom, 400% zoom at 320 px, text spacing) stated for the diagram? [Gap, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK021 Are requirements defined for reduced-motion preferences if the selection or scroll uses motion? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]

## Operability Without the Enhancement

- [x] CHK022 Are no-JavaScript accessibility requirements as strong as the JavaScript ones (names, focus, links)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK023 Is behaviour specified when the enhancement script fails to load or runs after a fragment arrival? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [x] CHK024 Is the new-tab source link's warning required in both visible text or accessible name and is that wording defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]

## Acceptance and Scope

- [x] CHK025 Does SC-003 cover each state (no part selected, a part selected, narrow width, forced colours) rather than only both themes? [Coverage, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK026 Is manual assistive-technology review (screen reader, keyboard-only) scoped as a requirement, given automated checks catch only part of WCAG? [Gap, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK027 Is plain-language reading level for explanations defined or measurable for WCAG readability expectations? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-013]
